method.scenarioScope: My auctions / My requests / My trades
method.fixture: one auction: Kitsune Pants-F at 100 ryo; no own requests/trades
method.serviceWorker: Normal application service worker enabled; network-first GET forwarding verified in sw.js and server GET logs. Browser ResourceTiming transferSize is zero for worker responses; reported bytes use encodedBodySize, not wire traffic.
method.samplingLimit: Observed loader/card-absence duration at 10 ms polling resolution; timing metrics are local development-server measurements, not production or isolated SQL/CPU timings.
method.order: All before trials, then all after trials; same account, data, browser, port and instrumentation. One warm-up per scenario/version omitted from five measured trials.
method.authentication: Disposable broker user in a dedicated Chrome isolatedContext; no credentials or request headers included.
method.measuredHTTPResponses: All measured target fetches returned HTTP 200; each typed prefix key uncached in a new QueryClient after full reload.
